title: The Provision of the Upper Fly River
author: B. M. Underhill
blurb: Xanthe Fairweather, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
